title: White-Box Sensitivity Auditing with Steering Vectors

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model output disparities by substituting explicit gender terms and implicitly gendered first names in prompts (black-box approach), and by measuring model sensitivity via manipulating latent representations using a gender steering vector extracted from gendered language datasets (white-box approach).

Assessing model decision disparities by varying explicit race terms, racialized first names, and English dialects (African American Language vs. White Mainstream English) in prompts, and by measuring model sensitivity through manipulating internal representations using a race steering vector (white-box approach).
